3DCT の表示を待ちましたが準備できず、LV データを適用できませんでした。C: Waited for the 3D CT to be displayed but it was not ready, so the LV data could not be applied. Display the CT, then drop the file again.
3D凸包はこのノブの影響を受けません。: 3D hull is not affected by this knob.
3×3の各セルに割り当てる操作（9種を1回ずつ）。アクティブなXA/IVUS画面: Operations assigned to each cell of the 3×3 grid (each of the 9 used once). Operate the active XA/IVUS view with the mouse alone. Toggle with the viewer's 'Mouse grid' button; released automatically during Measure.
9分割のグリッド線（区切り線）の表示／非表示。非表示にしても各セルの操作ラベルと: Show/hide the 9-cell grid lines (dividers). When hidden, each cell's operation label and hit area still work.
Aortic plane captured. Draw a Polygon in: Aortic plane captured. Draw a Polygon inside the LV cavity (Measure→Polygon), then press the Lumen ROI button.
Apex set. Adjust the blood HU range (下限/: Apex set. Adjust the blood HU range (Lower/Upper, default 200–500) using the All-Blood preview, then press 'LV-Blood' to compute the LV blood inside the Epi surface (light blue).
Auto-Endo の作り方 (方式) と形状/解像度。通常は既定のままで構いま: How Auto-Endo is built (method) and its shape/resolution. The defaults are usually fine. Smaller resolution values are finer but slower.
Auto-Endo の作り方: 凸包滑=短軸レベル凸包の頂点間を外に膨らむ滑らか: How Auto-Endo is built: Hull smooth = joins the short-axis-level convex hull vertices with smooth outward-bulging curves (recommended), Hull (layer) = the convex hull polygon as is, Hull (round) = pushed towards a circle (trabeculae), Radial = farthest blood in each direction (bridges trabecular valleys), 3D hull = 3-D convex hull
Blood + Endo sub-mode: set the blood HU: Blood + Endo sub-mode: set the blood HU range, compute the blood volume, then derive & edit the Endo border (needs Epi + MV/AoV) (right-click to show ⇔ hide Blood/Endo/LVD)
Blood + Endo sub-mode: set the blood HU range, measure the blood volume, then derive & edit the Endo border from it (needs Epi + MV/AoV) (right-click to show ⇔ hide Blood/Endo/LVD)
Build a time-ordered list of the open se: Build a time-ordered list of the open series (XA / IVUS / CT …) with your comments; click Show on a row to bring that image back exactly as captured — for walking through a case
CPRフォルダで更新しますか?\n追加 {a} 本 / 更新 {u} 本 / 削:
Update from the CPR folder?
Add {a} / Update {u} / Delete {d}
CPRフォルダと同期：役割・接続は保持したまま、フォルダの .cpr.json: Sync with the CPR folder: keeps roles and connections, updates centrelines from the folder's .cpr.json / removes vessels not in the folder from the list / adds new .cpr.json as unconnected (the original .cpr.json files are not modified)
CPRフォルダを選択（このCTの .cpr.json があるフォルダ）: Select the CPR folder (the folder with this CT's .cpr.json files)
Colour thresholds in mm for the 壁厚3D / 壁: Colour thresholds in mm for the Wall 3D / Wall SAX heat maps, thin→thick = red→green. Enter any number of ASCENDING values separated by commas (N values = N+1 colour bands). Default 5, 7, 9.
Compute + show the LV blood inside the E: Compute + show the LV blood inside the Epi surface (light blue) and its volume. Exclusive with All-Blood; recomputes on HU-range change.
Compute the LV blood first (adjust the H: Compute the LV blood first (adjust the HU range, press 'LV-Blood'), then Manual-Endo.
Compute the LV blood first (press 'LV-Bl: Compute the LV blood first (press 'LV-Blood'), then Manual-Endo.
CoronaryTree 編集モードへ移動：領域色・Epi・Blood・Endo: Go to CoronaryTree edit mode: hides territory colours, Epi, Blood, Endo and LVD and shows only the coronary CPR lines so they can be edited (enabled only when a .corotree.json is loaded)
Could not compute — {m}.\nAdjust the 下限/:
Could not compute — {m}.
Adjust the Lower/Upper HU range or re-check the Epi / MV / AoV.
Could not measure — {m}.\nAdjust 下限/上限,:
Could not measure — {m}.
Adjust Lower/Upper, move the ROI to a clearly-contrast part of the cavity, or re-check the Epi / MV / AoV.
Draw a Polygon inside the LV cavity (Mea: Draw a Polygon inside the LV cavity (Measure→Polygon), then press this: it colours the ROI, seeds it, and sets the HU range from the pixels inside — adjust Lower/Upper below.
Epi (myocardial) pass — align its long-a: Epi (myocardial) pass — align its long-axis view, Set axis, then Trace (right-click to show ⇔ hide the Epi border/region)
Epi loaded; the apex defaults to the Epi: Epi loaded; the apex defaults to the Epi apex. Adjust the blood HU range (Lower/Upper) with All-Blood, then press 'LV-Blood' / 'Endo-Border(Auto)'. (Press 'Apex' to set a different apex if needed.)
Epi または Blood/Endo が未完成です（Endo 境界・Epi 領域: Epi or Blood/Endo is incomplete (Endo border and Epi region required).
Epi 線を CT 値の心外膜エッジに自動適合し（HU 差が明瞭な所。小さい所は: Auto-fits the Epi line to the epicardial edge in the CT values (where the HU difference is clear; elsewhere the manual line is kept), then runs short-axis spline correction (8 sections excluding the apex) in one go. After that, move points on the long axis and press 'Spline corr.'.
Export した設定ファイルを読み込み、すべての設定をその内容に置き換えます。: Loads an exported settings file and replaces all settings with its contents.

FullLv を保存（Epi + Endo/Blood バンドル → Tools: Save FullLv (Epi + Endo/Blood bundle → Tools ▸ Territory)
FullLv 保存のためのデータを確認中…（少し時間がかかります）: Checking data for saving FullLv… (this takes a moment)
FullLv 保存済み — 再保存で上書きできます: FullLv saved — save again to overwrite

After moving points on the long axis, press 'Spline corr.'.
Instantly tint every voxel whose HU is i: Instantly tint every voxel whose HU is in the Lower–Upper range on both panes (no compute) — adjust Lower/Upper to optimise. Turned off automatically while LV-Blood is shown.
LMの太さ比（他の枝に対して）: LM thickness ratio (relative to other branches)
LV データの適用に失敗しました: {e}: Failed to apply the LV data: {e}

LV 編集モードへ移動：MV / AoV / Apex / Epi / Bloo: Go to LV edit mode: screen for editing MV / AoV / Apex / Epi / Blood-Endo (enabled only when a .FullLv.json is loaded)
LV-CoSync 開始: 2つのCTを同一縮尺・G同時ページング(mm)で連動: LV-CoSync started: the two CTs are linked at the same scale with simultaneous G paging (mm). Use 'LV length corr.' to switch to fractional linking.
LVD面をリセットしました。「LVD表示」で再設定できます。: LVD plane reset. You can set it again with 'LVD'.
Loaded the Blood landmarks. This file do: Loaded the Blood landmarks. This file does not contain the Epi border — press 'Load Epi' to load the matching EpiLv.json, then Calc Vol.
Loaded the {w} plane. Epi/Endo reuse the: Loaded the {w} plane. Epi/Endo reuse the existing trace with the new basal cut — re-press LV-Blood / Endo-Border(Auto) (or Calc Vol) to refresh the volumes.
Loaded — the last-saved state was restor: Loaded — the last-saved state was restored (blood / Auto-Endo / wall thickness with no recompute). The Epi in memory bounds the volume.
Loaded. The Epi currently in memory will: Loaded. The Epi currently in memory will be used — press 'Load Epi' to use a different EpiLv.json. Press Calc Vol to (re)compute the volume.
MV・AoV・Apex が揃っていません。先に「元CTで編集」で LV データを: MV, AoV and Apex are not all set. Load the LV data with 'Edit on source CT' first, then save.
MV・AoV・Apex の全てが開いていないと Epi / Blood は開けま: Epi / Blood cannot be opened unless MV, AoV and Apex are all open (missing: {m}). Drop MV, AoV and Apex together first.
No Epi surface — press 'Epi読み込み' to load: No Epi surface — press 'Load Epi' to load an EpiLv.json (or trace Epi in the Epi sub-mode) first.
Number of radial directions used by the: Number of radial directions used by the Radial method. Higher = finer angular detail, a little slower.
OFF: 同じmm(心尖からの絶対距離)で連動＝左室長の差が見える。ON: ap: OFF: linked by the same mm (absolute distance from the apex) = LV length differences are visible. ON: linked by apex→base fraction = full lengths aligned.
ON中、CT (VR/短軸) 上の血管をクリックで Target 設定。遠位の灌: While ON, click a vessel on the CT (VR/short axis) to set a Target. Its distal perfusion territory (mL, myocardium %) is shown in the table and image
Press LV-Blood表示 (or Auto-Endo表示) first: Press LV-Blood (or Endo-Border(Auto)) first to compute the blood pool, then Wall thickness.
ROI captured. Blood HU range set to {lo:: ROI captured. Blood HU range set to {lo:.0f}–{hi:.0f} from the ROI (min {mn:.0f} / max {mx:.0f}). Adjust Lower/Upper if needed, then press CalcVol.

Show the LV diameter (LVD) at a MANUAL mitral-leaflet-tip level. Press → 'Measure' (measure at the current section) or 'Set plane, then measure' (set the section first, then press again). Right-click to re-set.
Territory（灌流領域 + VR）表示へ移動（.FullLv.json と: Go to Territory (perfusion territory + VR) display (enabled only when both a .FullLv.json and a .corotree.json are loaded)
VR モデル（灌流テリトリーの色付き曲面＋冠動脈チューブ）を、ブラウザで回せる: Exports the VR model (coloured perfusion territory surfaces + coronary tubes) as a self-contained HTML (or .glb) you can rotate in a browser. 3D meshes are generated with marching cubes + smoothing (requires scikit-image).
VR モデル（灌流領域サーフェス＋冠動脈＋ターゲット）を、ブラウザで回せる 自己: Exports the VR model (perfusion territory surfaces + coronaries + targets) as a self-contained HTML (or .glb) you can rotate in a browser. 3D meshes are generated with marching cubes + smoothing (requires scikit-image).
Wall-thickness heat map — Endo→Epi NEARE: Wall-thickness heat map — Endo→Epi NEAREST distance (3-D). Build the Auto-Endo first; needs the Epi surface + MV/AoV. Only one of Wall 3D / Wall SAX shows at a time.
Wall-thickness heat map — RADIAL (short-: Wall-thickness heat map — RADIAL (short-axis / echo-style) from the LV long axis, to compare with echocardiography. Mutually exclusive with Wall 3D.
apex からの絶対 mm で対応（左室長の差が見える）: Match by absolute mm from the apex (LV length differences are visible)
apex→M弁中心を 0〜100% で対応（左室長が違っても同じ相対レベルを並べ: Match apex→mitral valve centre as 0–100% (shows the same relative levels side by side even if LV lengths differ = for comparing phases)
no in-range blood inside the Epi surface: no in-range blood inside the Epi surface — adjust the Lower/Upper HU range
{m} 個のフォルダを読み込み中… 完了後に「状態更新」を押すと[表示]が有効に: Loading {m} folder(s)… When done, press 'Refresh status' to enable [Show].
{name} とその下流の枝 {k} 本を削除しますか? (元のCPRファイルは: Delete {name} and its {k} downstream branch(es)? (The original CPR files are kept)
{n} 個のファイルを元の場所に戻しました（読込完了後に表示できます）。: Restored {n} file(s) to their original location (can be shown once loading completes).
{n} 行 / コメント未入力 {e} 行 (赤い欄にコメントを入力)。 基準: {n} rows / {e} without comment (enter comments in the red cells).  Reference: {ref}
※同名ファイルが {d} 件あり最後の1つを採用。: * {d} files with the same name; the last one was used.
この LV データの元となった3DCTフォルダを選択してください: Select the 3D CT folder this LV data was created from
このCPR線を短軸で再計算 (ReCalc): Recompute this CPR line on the short axis (ReCalc)
このCTの .cpr.json がフォルダに見つかりませんでした。: No .cpr.json for this CT was found in the folder.
このシリーズの元ファイルを、画像フォルダの親にある CasePresentati: Move this series' source files to the CasePresentation-Erase folder in the image folder's parent (can be undone)
このシリーズは現在読み込まれていません (閉じられた可能性があります)。元のフォ: This series is not currently loaded (it may have been closed). Reopen its original folder.
このデータは未保存ですが、そのまま終了していいですか?: This data has not been saved. Quit anyway?
このファイルには元の3DCTの情報がありません。適用するCTを選んでください（別: This file has no source 3D CT information. Choose the CT to apply it to (applying it to a different CT will misalign it).
このペインのCTが元の3DCTか確認できません（{c}）。: Cannot confirm that the CT in this pane is the source 3D CT ({c}).
このペインのCTは、このファイルの元の3DCTではありません（{c}）。: The CT in this pane is not this file's source 3D CT ({c}).
このペインの画像は、このファイルの元の3DCTではありません（{c}）。: The image in this pane is not this file's source 3D CT ({c}).
この点で灌流域を再計算しますか？: Recompute the perfusion territory at this point?
この短軸(CPR)の元となった3DCTフォルダを選択してください: Select the 3D CT folder this short axis (CPR) was created from
この短軸CPRを .cpr.json に保存し、続けて Coronary Tre: Save this short-axis CPR to .cpr.json and register it in the Coronary Tree (sorted by source 3D CT). The file name becomes the vessel name.
この線で短軸CPRを作成 (Coronary): Create a short-axis CPR from this line (Coronary)
この行のキー画像を現在の表示で更新しました。: Updated this row's key image with the current view.
この行をプレゼンから除外（元ファイルは残す）: Exclude this row from the presentation (source files are kept)
すべての設定（この画面の内容 + 検査種別ごとの DICOM タグ表示項目など）: Exports all settings (this dialog + per-modality DICOM tag display items, etc.) to one settings file. Importing it on another PC gives the same settings.
そのフォルダには読み込める画像がありませんでした。: That folder contains no loadable images.
その位置は高HVの腔ではありません（造影された腔 HU 200–1000 の 内: That position is not a high-HU cavity (click inside a contrast-filled cavity, HU 200–1000).
アクティブなペインの表示を1行として取り込む: Capture the active pane's view as one row
オンにして心腔(LV/RV)の内部をクリック → その血液プールを抽出し スナッ: Turn on and click inside a heart cavity (LV/RV) → that blood pool is extracted and excluded from snapping (prevents an occluded coronary from sticking to the cavity). Do not use on the aorta (it leaks into the proximal coronaries)
グリッドが表示されてから自動で消えるまでの時間。「継続」でずっと表示したままにな: Time from when the grid appears until it hides automatically. 'Keep' leaves it shown.
シリーズが見つかりません (検査を表示してから押してください)。: No series found (show a study first, then press this).
テリトリーの VR モデルがありません。先に CT Territory を表示し: No territory VR model. Show the CT Territory first.
トレース点を造影ルーメンへ自動スナップ（深さ補正）。閉塞部などで腔へ引き寄せられ: Auto-snap trace points to the contrast lumen (depth correction). Turn off if points get pulled into a cavity, e.g. at an occlusion. Large high-HU cavities are ignored automatically. Moving existing points never snaps
ドラッグ=回転 ・ ホイール=拡大縮小 ・ 右ドラッグ=平行移動: Drag = rotate · Wheel = zoom · Right-drag = pan
ファイルの記録と選んだCTが一致しません（{d}）。別のCTに適用すると位置が合: The file's record does not match the chosen CT ({d}). Applying it to a different CT will misalign it. Apply anyway?
フォルダを再指定して読込中… 完了後に右クリック →「状態更新」で [表示] が: Loading from the relinked folder… When done, right-click → 'Refresh status' to enable [Show] (relinked automatically by SeriesUID; {n} row(s)).
ルート (LM / LAD / LCX / RCA) を1本以上設定してください: Set at least one root (LM / LAD / LCX / RCA). Right-click a vessel → 'Role' to set it.
ルート(LM/LAD/LCX/RCA)の親は変更できません。役割を「枝」に変えて: The parent of a root (LM/LAD/LCX/RCA) cannot be changed. Change its role to 'Branch' first, then connect it.
一度HU補正済みです。再試行すると用手修正された内容が上書きされます。: HU correction has already been applied. Retrying will overwrite manual corrections.
一番奥のCPR編集点へジャンプ（Shift+F）: Jump to the farthest CPR edit point (Shift+F)
一番手前のCPR編集点へジャンプ（Shift+A）: Jump to the nearest CPR edit point (Shift+A)
一番最初の行へ移動して表示: Go to the first row and show
一番最後の行へ移動して表示: Go to the last row and show
下の血管リストで選択した血管（下流の枝を含む）を一覧から消去。Ctrlで複数選択: Remove the vessels selected in the list below (including downstream branches). Ctrl = multi-select, Shift = range (the original CPR files are kept)
両ペインのHU疑似カラー表示を切替: Toggle HU pseudo-colour display on both panes
両ペインのSlab-MIP厚 (0=薄いMPR): Slab-MIP thickness for both panes (0 = thin MPR)
両ペインの表示位置をリセット（初期位置で再クリックすると W/L も）: Reset the view position of both panes (click again at the initial position to also reset W/L)
両ペインを同じズームに合わせ直す（各自でズームした後に）: Re-match both panes to the same zoom (after zooming each one)
乳頭筋/肉柱の谷を橋渡しする角度幅。大=谷を大きく跨ぐ。: Angular width for bridging papillary muscle/trabecular valleys. Large = spans wider valleys.
保存しました。Coronary Tree パネルを開けませんでした。: Saved. Could not open the Coronary Tree panel.
保存・登録してから冠動脈MPR/短軸モードを自動で終了します（Save→Exit: Save and register, then exit the coronary MPR/short-axis mode automatically (Save→Exit in one step). Does not exit if the save is cancelled.
保存用データの作成に失敗しました: {e}: Failed to create the data to save: {e}
元の3DCTが特定できません。CPRを読み込み直すかフォルダを選択してください。: Cannot identify the source 3D CT. Reload the CPR or select its folder.
元の3DCTが見つかりません（{c}）。元の3DCTフォルダを選択してください: Source 3D CT not found ({c}). Select the source 3D CT folder
元の3DCTのフォルダを指定するか、キャンセルしてください。: Specify the source 3D CT folder, or cancel.
元の3DCTデータが見つかりません。元の3DCTフォルダを選択してください: Source 3D CT data not found. Select the source 3D CT folder
先に Epi をトレースしてください（3 面以上）。: Trace Epi first (3 or more planes).
先に Epi をトレースしてください（MV / AoV / Apex 設定後）。: Trace Epi first (after setting MV / AoV / Apex).
先に FullLv を読み込んでください（Territory 未計算）。: Load a FullLv first (Territory not computed).
全ての血管を消去 (.cpr.json は残る): Remove all vessels (.cpr.json files are kept)
冠動脈の見た目を設定します（アプリ修正不要）。太さ・LM比・境界(ハロー)の色/: Sets the coronary appearance (no app change needed): thickness, LM ratio, border (halo) colour/transparency, and each territory/target colour. VR thickness/halo work on both Windows and Mac.
冠動脈ツリーと FullLv の元CT(SeriesUID)が一致しません。結果: The source CT (SeriesUID) of the coronary tree and the FullLv do not match. Results may be incorrect. Continue?
冠動脈ツリーを3DCTに重畳 (再クリックで非表示)。未読込なら自動読込: Overlay the coronary tree on the 3D CT (click again to hide). Loads automatically if not loaded
凸包(層)はこのノブの影響を受けません(凸包そのまま)。: Hull (layer) is not affected by this knob (convex hull as is).

列の表示/非表示を切り替え（ヘッダの ✕ でも非表示）: Show/hide columns (or hide with the ✕ in the header)
前のCPR編集点へ移動（調整用、A）: Move to the previous CPR edit point (for adjustment, A)
前の行へ移動して表示: Go to the previous row and show
右画面のVR (立体表示) を表示/非表示: Show/hide the VR (3D view) in the right pane
各セルに操作を割り当ててください（配置は保存しませんでした）。: Assign an operation to each cell (the layout was not saved).

基準「{ref}」の行と、それ以外のモダリティの行を1行ずつ選んでください。: Select one row of the reference '{ref}' and one row of another modality.
基準以外のモダリティがありません。: There is no modality other than the reference.
基準行と他モダリティ行をちょうど2行選択してください。: Select exactly 2 rows: a reference row and an other-modality row.
壁厚ヒートマップ(3D)の表示 / 非表示: Show / hide wall thickness heat map (3D)
壁厚ヒートマップ(短軸)の表示 / 非表示: Show / hide wall thickness heat map (short axis)
